notes: Reference date 2018-04-19. Governing document: DFA collective agreement 2014-2017 (2018_01), in force 'including any period of negotiation until a new Collective Agreement is signed' (35.01). The 2017-2020 successor was ratified by the Board on 2018-03-01 (2018_06) and reportedly signed 2018-04-18 per its version note; its text is not saved, and the DFA bulletin of 2018-03-19 (2018_02) says it was still to be updated 'for final signing'. Every component citing 2018_01/2018_03 carries version_uncertain.

2018_01's pages after 9116 include OCR-garbled Labour Board certificates, unreadable in parts. 2018_03's Article 30 text is identical in substance to 2018_01 Art. 30; 2018_04 holds the Art. 35 term; 2018_06 is a ratification notice, no policy; 2018_07 is a navigation page pointing to Clause 30.08, no policy of its own.

CA 30.08(f) pays 95% for each week of a two-week EI waiting period. On the reference date EI's waiting period was one week (EI Act s. 13), so the clause's condition did not hold and it is not coded (R21, Manitoba example); recorded here and in c2's duration_note.

The agreement's pregnancy leave restates the statute ('consistent in timing and duration with the Labour Standards Code'), so it is coded as the statute (c1); the agreement relies on the statute's parental leave (c3) and adds only pay (top-ups) and 'further unpaid leave ... not unreasonably denied' (c8, no length).

Paths by eligibility (U8): the member (two years' service, EI-eligible) gets the one-year-service 14-week top-ups (c4, c7). A Member without EI-insurable earnings gets no top-up; the 17-week top-ups need no Dalhousie service minimum.

Birth parent chain: LSC pregnancy leave 17 (c1; EI maternity c9 from week 2, SUB top-up c2 within it from week 2) -> LSC parental leave 35 (c3; birth-parent top-up 14 c4 within it from its start; EI parental c10 after EI maternity) -> further unpaid leave (c8, no length); leave_limits 52 combined.

Non-birth parent chain: LSC parental leave 52 from the birth (c3); either the 5-day full-salary leave (c5) or the top-ups: 17 weeks (c6, within c3 from week 2 with EI parental c10) -> 14 weeks (c7, consecutive_after c6); c5 in_lieu_of c6 and c7 -> further unpaid leave (c8).

Not components: 32.16 daycare facilities (no leave, pay or relief); 33.07 refusal of dangerous work and temporary alternative duties (general workplace hazard, not pregnancy-specific); 4.01 no discrimination (family relationship, sex); 20.05(e) reduced workload in the first two probationary years (not tied to a birth); 15.13(c) tenure deferral for excess workload (not usable for a birth); jury, political, sabbatical, retraining, educational leaves.
Calendar: the agreement names academic terms (Sept-Dec, Jan-Apr, May-Aug, 1.03) but no component is measured in terms, so calendar is omitted.
